thread:
Mia Chen: ap-southeast1 facing a sudden traffic spike and the GPU autoscaler is thrashing — scale-up lagging, a bunch of pods Pending with Insufficient GPU.
Oliver Park: seeing it too. load from realtime-infer spiked ~3x. pods show Pending + ImagePullBackOff sometimes but mostly Pending: Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu.
autoscaler-bot: [AUTOSCALER] scale_up failed for pool-gpu-a (ap-southeast1): quotaExceeded (403). retrying with backoff.
Sanjay Rao: fyi events from k8s:
```
Events:
  Type     Reason            Age   From               Message
  ----     ------            ----  ----               -------
  Warning  FailedScheduling  2m (x14)  default-scheduler  0/10 nodes are available: 10 Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu.
  Warning  FailedCreate      1m (x6)   cloud-controller     failed to create instance: quota exceeded, api error 429
```
Kira Lee: cloud console shows GPU quota maxed for ap-southeast1 and provider API rate-limiting (429) when we call batch create. also a partial outage on a subset of GPU SKUs.
Oliver Park: can we circuit-break or shift traffic to us-central1? latency slightly higher but keeps the service alive.
Mia Chen: starting emergency traffic shift — updating inference-route to prefer us-central1 and add fallback. doing a 15% incremental shift now. :rocket:
deploy-bot: route-update job started: inference-route -> add us-central1 fallback (15% initial).
Mia Chen: autoscaler config check: cooldown=60s and aggressive scale-down is on -> likely causing oscillation when provision fails. increasing cooldown to 300s and temporarily disabling scale-down for 10m.
Sanjay Rao: manually bumped pool-gpu-a max_nodes 20 -> 40 as stopgap while provider escalates quota. note: provider returns mixed success for provisioning (some nodes stuck in PROVISIONING).
autoscaler-bot: [AUTOSCALER] scale_up initiated: provisioning 6 nodes for pool-gpu-a (request id x-93a).
Kira Lee: opened provider ticket INC-3421 requesting emergency quota bump + SKU availability confirmation. cc @finance for cost heads-up.
Oliver Park: cost will take a hit while we soak traffic in other regions and oversize pools — acknowledged.
Mia Chen: observed that the autoscaler retries quickly on failures which amplifies API rate-limits. filed immediate mitigation: exponential backoff on provider API errors and suppress scale-down during error windows.
Sanjay Rao: once nodes appear they need GPU drivers / nvidia daemonset — 2 nodes failed init due to image pull timeout, restarted successfully after driver artifact mirror fallback. adding mirror fallback to init script.
Mia Chen: after ~12 minutes new nodes transitioned to Ready and pending pods started scheduling. starting gradual traffic rollback to ap-southeast1.
deploy-bot: route-update job: rollback step 1 -> 50% traffic to ap-southeast1, 50% us-central1.
Oliver Park: follow-ups: 1) increase default cooldown to 180s, 2) add sustained-load pre-warm policy for scheduled experiments, 3) add provider API rate-limit detection to autoscaler metrics/alerts, 4) document rapid traffic-shift playbook.
Sanjay Rao: creating RFC and runbook PR for pre-warm + backoff + cooldown changes. will include cost tradeoffs and runbook steps for manual pool increase and cross-region shift.
Mia Chen: I'll draft the incident summary and post to #incidents, include timeline, root causes (quota + provider SKU availability + aggressive cooldown), mitigations, and action items. closing this live thread — monitoring for 30m. :white_check_mark:
